expires_today.title: The Ultimate Python Development Bundle by Packt
expires_today.description: Learn Python without the spendy pricetag
expires_today.long_description: Build websites and software, automate tasks, analyze data, and more using Python—the star of our latest Tech Book Bundle with Packt. Pay what you want for a curated 21-title selection that can help transform your development cycle and career prospects. Unlock fundamental eBooks like Python Illustrated, a visual deep dive into the basics of Python coding, Time Series Analysis with Python Cookbook - 2E, and everything else you need to dip your toes into one of the most versatile programming languages on the market, while helping support the Python Software Foundation with your purchase.

expires_today.title: Ultimate Stylized Bundle by SICS Games
expires_today.long_description: Toon-up your personal asset library with an injection of pure fun! We’ve teamed up with SICS Games on a unique cartoon-style bundle filled with vibrant color, fantastic designs, and easy-to-use UIs that fit seamlessly into whatever project you’re working on. Dive headfirst into new genres with hit asset packs like Toon Nature Assets, Toon Deserted Temples, Toon Adventure Island, and Toon Enchanted Meadow before it’s too late. Bring joy and exuberance to your next project with stylized toon assets today and help support No Kid Hungry.

expires_today.title: 2K Megahits 2026 Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
If your gaming library needs a summer refresh, look no further than this bundle of publisher 2K’s greatest hits!! Here you’ll find monster battling games, steampunk adventures, mobster action, and everything in between. Survive a hostile alien planet full of vicious beasts and plenty of loot in Risk of Rain 2! Work your way up the crime family ladder and become mobster royalty without getting whacked in Mafia II: Definitive Edition! Save a woman from a flying city and discover the secrets of BioShock Infinite! There are even more hidden gems and fan favorites to explore in this bundle, so grab it now at the price of your choosing and support Covenant House with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem and activate on Steam before February 7th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Even Steamier Sakura Special
expires_today.long_description:
The content in this bundle is intended for mature audiences.

Add some spice to your summer with the 2026 Even Steamier Sakura Bundle of titillating titles! Are you ready for Mei-Mei? Your favorite bunny girls are back and more voluptuous than ever with Sakura Bunny Girls 1 & 2, the romantic visual novel games where you, an average Joe, encounter gorgeous supergirls! Or find love within the Sakura Isekai Adventure series, a set of yuri adventures that mixes real-life situations with cat-eared cuties! Turn up the heat and the fun with this epic collection by Winged Cloud, and help support Direct Relief with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 7th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Cosmos Eclipse Game Dev Assets & Tools bundle (Unreal + Unity + Godot)
expires_today.long_description:
Unleash your creative potential and bring your imagination to life like never before with a curated selection of premium 3D assets for Unity and Unreal Engine! Design your own take on the Big Apple with the 1950s NYC Megapack, quarter your forces within realistic fortifications with the Military Base Megapack, or add lived-in grit and character to your old-time titles with the Medieval Village Megapack. The savings don’t stop there—grab this massive 70+ pack bundle and unlock a 1-month subscription to Leartes’ Cosmos collection! Plus, a portion of your purchase helps support our furry friends at Canine Companions!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 1st, 2027.

expires_today.title: Squad Goals
expires_today.long_description:
Grab a friend or two and cozy up with the Squad Goals Bundle, an epic collection of co-op titles perfect for staying connected with your bestie this summer. Use your Turtle Power to rescue Master Splinter from the evil Foot Clan in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate, a rad roguelike with endless replayability that comes packed with the Metalhead DLC! Or race against the clock to get dishes out hot in PlateUp!, a fast-paced restaurant management sim! Pay what you want for eight amazing co-op games and help support Child's Play when you shop with Humble!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before January 31st, 2027.
